import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length1_37/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length1_37/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Perform the join on ['business_id', 'date'] as specified
df_joined = pd.merge(df0, df1, on=['business_id', 'date'], how='inner')

# Ensure columns are in the target schema order and types:
# Target Schema: ['business_id': int, 'Score': float, 'date': int, 'type': str, 'ViolationTypeID': int, 'risk_category': str, 'description': str]

# Convert columns to correct types
df_joined['business_id'] = df_joined['business_id'].astype(int)
df_joined['Score'] = df_joined['Score'].astype(float)
df_joined['date'] = df_joined['date'].astype(int)
df_joined['type'] = df_joined['type'].astype(str)
df_joined['ViolationTypeID'] = df_joined['ViolationTypeID'].astype(int)
df_joined['risk_category'] = df_joined['risk_category'].astype(str)
df_joined['description'] = df_joined['description'].astype(str)

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
df_target = df_joined[['business_id', 'Score', 'date', 'type', 'ViolationTypeID', 'risk_category', 'description']]

# Write the final target table to the specified path without the index
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_37/target_multisource.csv"
df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
